decision.summary: A multi-sample negative offset begins around index 665–668 in all three components (U > E > N in amplitude), followed by a relatively stable segment until ~685, then a noisy decline. A partial recovery appears in U and E near 695–700 but is incomplete and lacks N-axis confirmation; the return is unobserved or ambiguous before the allowed context ends at 729. Thus, the interval from 665 to 694 is classified as uncertain temporary offset.

intervals.observation: Multi-axis negative offset onset at ~665–668 (U drops ~3 MAD, E ~2 MAD, N ~1 MAD), sustained platform-like behavior until ~685, then continued noisy decline; no clear opposing return observed before index 695. U and E show partial recovery near 695–700 but not to pre-offset levels and with insufficient coherence across all axes to confirm full return.
